product_summary: Vertically integrated textile manufacturer (LNJ Bhilwara Group), set up 1991, three units (Maral, Sarovar, Noida). Stated monthly capacity: 1700 t grey yarn, 300 t dyed yarn, 700 t dyed knitted fabric, 500,000 garment pieces. Four product lines: (1) Yarn — blended/innovative yarns for knitting, weaving, towels, sweaters, socks, home furnishing, denim, protective workwear; (2) Fabric — knit fabrics, dyed/printed/brushed/sueded, innerwear and outerwear; (3) Garments — fashionwear, prints, woven, hand-embellished tops (sequin/bead/crochet/ari embroidery), rotary/heat-transfer/placement prints, tie & dye; (4) Melange. Raw material: BCI, organic, FairTrade, recycled cotton. Source: https://www.maraloverseas.com/ (homepage, product-range and capacity statements).
comment: INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: declared industry 'Продукты питания и FMCG' (food & FMCG) is wrong — the company is a pure textile/yarn/fabric/garment manufacturer. No food, FMCG or consumer-goods line appears anywhere on the site. HS MATCH: PARTIAL. Declared 5205.26 and 5205.28 are cotton yarn subheadings (single yarn, combed, >43 nm / >52 nm) and are plausible for the grey/dyed cotton yarn line — but the site publishes no HS codes, no count/Nm specifications and no composition breakdown, so the exact subheading cannot be corroborated: 'заявлено, не подтверждено'. MISSING FROM DECLARATION: the entire fabric line (knitted fabrics, HS ch. 60), the entire garment line (HS ch. 61/62, incl. protective workwear), melange yarns, and all blended/synthetic-staple yarns (HS ch. 55) — i.e. three of the four product lines and most of the value chain are absent from the declared codes. Also note dyed yarn would normally sit in 5205.4x, not 5205.2x. Trader signs: none — own manufacturing units and stated capacities indicate a producer, not a trader. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, codes to be corrected to the actual textile range (ch. 52/55/60/61/62). No customs lines were available to me in this task, so no shipment-level corroboration is asserted; revenue, volumes and registry data not researched per role scope.
